fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

You are a meticulously organised Project Support Officer who is willing to muck in boots and all at any level in the business to help us keep multiple entities organised and on track!

You will be required to ensure that all entities are up to date with their filings, that we have covered appropriate legals for all directors and board members and verify that all legal agreements are up to date for each of the entities.

You will be working closely with the Chief of Staff and VP of Product Operations to ensure the right people are on the right tasks across the Operations team and generally making sure that our heads remain firmly attached to our bodies.

We are looking for someone to keep many plates spinning in sync with each other while also keeping an eye on what's coming down the pipeline and highlighting any appropriate sign offs and legals required.

There will be BAU tasks required as well as opportunities to sink your teeth into larger projects, but overall you are looking at an overarching view of the universe of companies, their links and ensuring everything remains running smoothly at all times.


What will you be doing?

  • Ensuring the project plan, risks, issues and actions are kept up to date and escalating tasks as required to the relevant manager
  • Ensuring weekly and monthly reports are updated
  • Ensuring time and deliverables and correctly invoiced and paid
  • Provide operational support with meeting organisation, minute taking and distribution, cross team communication and other operational support
  • Identify process improvements and better ways of working to maximise efficiency
  • Working closely with the Chief of Staff and VP of Operations on resource planning

What skills do you need?

  • Min 2 years commercial experience within a PMO or Project Support role
  • Extra points if you have been on a management consultant grad scheme!
  • Demonstrable experience of managing operational functions with minimal supervision
  • Highly literate with Excel and ideally G-Suite
  • Ability to build strong and effective relationships with senior stakeholders and wider team members
  • Exceptional organisational skills
  • Understanding of the Crypto industry is a plus, but not essential


Who are we?

At Radix, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

Radix went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

In return for working with us, you get to work remotely on your own schedule (or the option to get a local co-working space if preferred), work at the cutting edge of new technology and benefit from an education budget to use to further develop your skills!


If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply directly via the link or email farrah@radixdlt.com for more information.
